title: Law requiring reporting of AI safety incidents in city contracts
summary: This bill would require city contractors and agencies to notify the Office of Cyber Command within 24 hours of any reportable artificial intelligence safety incident, such as a security breach or loss of control of an AI model. The Office of Cyber Command would set standards for identifying such incidents, publicly post incident disclosures within 24 hours and issue an annual summary report. The law would take effect 180 days after passage.
